messages:
mara: Idea: route short requests (<50 tokens) from /v1/generate -> /v2/generate to test perf/cost. want console preview + clear billing trace before we enable.
jonathan: Short requests are most latency-sensitive. Agree but billing must show "origin" vs "routed" so customers understand delta.
lee: Implementation: add header X-RW-Origin-Version and emit event fields origin_version/routed_version. billing can choose which to present.
sam: Also watch quota contiguity: if tenant has v1 quota but routed calls count against v2 quota, support will riot. Need per-tenant mapping or quota shadowing.
anna-ux: UX ask: per-route preview with toggle "route short requests" -> shows 7d sample, estimated token change, and which tenants would hit quota changes. include a compatibility score.
mara: Rollout plan: dry-run -> 2% -> 20% -> 100%. auto-rollback if p95 +20% or error_rate +0.4% or quota_exhaustion_spike observed.
jonathan: Emit metric compat.short_route_count and quota.mapping_conflicts. Add alert when conflicts > 5 tenants in 1h.
lee: Router precedence: respect explicit prefer_version header, then console pin, then short-request rule. Unit tests needed for precedence matrix.
sam: For billing, propose dual-reporting for 30 days: invoice shows billed_as (routed) and note "origin breakdown available". Also add console link from invoice line to route preview.
mara: Actions: lee implement header+metrics (owner: lee), sam coordinate billing dual-reporting (sam), anna-ux sketch modal (anna-ux), jonathan add router tests (jonathan). Aim for preview by Wed EOD.
deploy-bot: (system) scheduled: canary job queued 1779009999 -> will post results here.
